title: Subscription for the Lazio Fan Token (LAZIO) Token Sale on Binance Launchpad Is Now Open
text: Fellow Binancians, Subscription for the Lazio Fan Token (LAZIO) token sale on Binance Launchpad is now open and will remain open for 4 hours. Users can check their eligibility and commit their BNB to the  Lazio Fan Token (LAZIO) token sale  based on their past 7-day average BNB holdings. The BNB rate for the LAZIO token sale has been set below. Further information: 1 LAZIO = 0.00201329 BNB or 1 USD (using a BNB price of 495.70 USD). Users will have 4 hours to subscribe by committing their BNB tokens between 2021-10-21 06:00 AM (UTC) and 2021-10-21 10:00 AM (UTC). Users must also sign the LAZIO Token Purchase Agreement prior to committing their BNB. The maximum amount of BNB that each user can commit has been calculated based on their past 7-day  average BNB balance . Important:  Only BNB in user spot wallets can be used to commit. If your BNB is in other accounts such as Launchpool or BNB Vault, you will need to redeem them to your spot wallet first before committing. Please note that once committed, your BNB will be  locked  and you will not be able to redeem or access any other functions such as transfers, withdrawals or trading until final token distribution.  After the subscription period ends at 2021-10-21 10:00 AM (UTC), the LAZIO token allocation calculation will begin and will take a total of 1 hour. The final LAZIO token allocation results will be revealed at 2021-10-21 11:00 AM (UTC), at which point the respective BNB will be deducted from your already-locked BNB amount within 30 minutes. Once deducted, your LAZIO and remaining BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet. Reminder: There is a hard cap of 20,000 USD (20,000 LAZIO or 40.2658 BNB) that can be allocated per user. For detailed calculation rules, click  here .  The Lazio Fan Token (LAZIO) BEP-20 smart contract is available  here . After the subscription is complete, Binance will list Lazio Fan Token (LAZIO) in the innovation zone at 2021-10-21 12:00 PM (UTC) and open trading for LAZIO/BTC, LAZIO/USDT, LAZIO/TRY and LAZIO/EUR trading pairs. Further Information: Lazio Fan Token (LAZIO) Project Research Report Introducing the Lazio Fan Token (LAZIO) Token Sale on Binance Launchpad! Launchpad Subscription Format FAQ Reminder: Users need to complete their account verification and also be from an eligible jurisdiction to participate in this token sale.  * Users from the following countries or regions will not be able to participate in token sales on the Binance Launchpad platform:  Belarus, People's Republic of China, Democratic Republic of Congo, Cuba, Iraq, Iran, North Korea, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, United States of America and its territories (American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands), Zimbabwe.
